title: ICAR-IIVR Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot Management Advisory
content:
Crop: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
Disease: Septoria Leaf Spot (Septoria lycopersici)
Region: Punjab & National Vegetable Belts
Authoritative Source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://iivr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Identification & Symptoms:
• Leaves: Small circular spots (2-3 mm) with dark brown margins and gray/tan sunken centers containing tiny black fruiting bodies (pycnidia).
• Progression: Infection initiates on lower leaves near soil level and spreads upward, causing severe defoliation, sunscald of fruits, and vigor loss.

2. Immediate Cultural Precautions:
• Plant Staking: Stake tomato plants to keep foliage elevated away from wet soil.
• Pruning: Prune out infected lower leaves up to 20-30 cm above soil level.
• Mulching: Apply organic straw or silver-black reflective plastic mulch to prevent soil-splash dispersal of fungal spores.

3. Sanitation Guidance:
• Remove and burn crop residues immediately after final harvest.
• Disinfect pruning tools with 70% alcohol.
• Practice 2-3 year crop rotation away from solanaceous crops (potato, brinjal, chilli).

4. Moisture & Irrigation:
• Use drip irrigation; strictly avoid overhead sprinkler irrigation that keeps leaves wet.
• Irrigate in morning hours so foliage dries quickly during daylight.

5. Non-Chemical Management:
• Apply Trichoderma harzianum or Bacillus subtilis foliar bio-fungicide formulations prophylactically.

6. Chemical Treatment (CIBRC / ICAR Approved):
• Foliar Spray: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0-2.5 g/L of water or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L at first appearance of spots.
• Repeat Spray: Reapply after 10-14 days if wet, humid weather conditions persist.

7. Safe Usage & Limitations:
• Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 10 to 14 days. Discontinue spraying 10 days before tomato fruit harvest.
• Observe personal protective measures when mixing and spraying.
source_name: ICAR-Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) / PAU
cultural_precautions: Stake plants; prune lower leaves; apply straw mulch to prevent soil splash.
sanitation_guidance: Destroy infected plant residues; rotate out of Solanaceae for 2-3 seasons.
moisture_irrigation_guidance: Drip irrigation strictly; avoid sprinkler splash; water early in morning.
chemical_treatment: Foliar spray: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0-2.5 g/L or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Mancozeb 75% WP and Copper Oxychloride 50% WP registered under Insecticides Act 1968 for tomato foliar diseases.
phi_safety_limitations: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI): 10-14 days; wear personal protective gear.
content_hi:
फसल: टमाटर (Tomato)
रोग: सेप्टोरिया पत्ती धब्बा (Septoria Leaf Spot - Septoria lycopersici)
क्षेत्र: पंजाब एवं राष्ट्रीय सब्जी क्षेत्र
प्रामाणिक स्रोत: ICAR-IIVR / पंजाब कृषि विश्वविद्यालय (PAU)
आधिकारिक पोर्टल: https://iivr.icar.gov.in

1. लक्षण एवं पहचान:
• पत्तियों पर गहरे भूरे किनारों और भूरे-सफेद केंद्रों वाले छोटे गोल धब्बे (2-3 मिमी), जिनमें काले रंग के बिंदु (पिक्नीडिया) दिखाई देते हैं।
• रोग पहले निचली पत्तियों पर शुरू होकर ऊपर की ओर बढ़ता है।

2. सांस्कृतिक व स्वच्छता प्रबंधन:
• पौधों को सहारा (Staking) दें और जमीन से छूने वाली निचली पत्तियों को तोड़कर नष्ट करें।
• मिट्टी से छीटों को रोकने के लिए पुआल या प्लास्टिक मल्च का उपयोग करें।
• ड्रिप सिंचाई का उपयोग करें; फव्वारा सिंचाई से बचें।

3. अनुशंसित रासायनिक उपचार (CIBRC / ICAR अनुमोदित):
• मैंकोजेब 75% डब्ल्यूपी (Mancozeb 75% WP) @ 2.0-2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी या कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड 50% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें।
• तुड़ाई पूर्व अंतराल (PHI): 10-14 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIVR Tomato Early Blight (Alternaria solani) Advisory
content:
Crop: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
Disease: Early Blight (Alternaria solani)
Region: Punjab & National Vegetable Belts
Authoritative Source: ICAR-Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://iivr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Identification & Symptoms:
• Dark brown to black spots with characteristic concentric rings creating a 'target board' pattern on older leaves, surrounded by yellow chlorotic halo.
• Fruit lesions are dark, leathery, and sunken at the stem-end.

2. Management Practices:
• Cultural: Remove lower blighted leaves; maintain wide row spacing for air movement; avoid excess nitrogen.
• Non-chemical: Spray Trichoderma viride formulations prophylactically.
• Chemical Treatment (CIBRC Approved): Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1.0 mL/L at first disease detection. Repeat at 10-12 day intervals.
• Safety & PHI: Pre-Harvest Interval is 7-10 days.
source_name: ICAR-Indian Institute of Vegetable Research (IIVR) / PAU
cultural_precautions: Wide row spacing; removal of lower affected leaves.
moisture_irrigation_guidance: Avoid sprinkler irrigation; water at base.
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.0 g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1.0 mL/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Mancozeb 75% WP registered for tomato early blight under Insecticides Act.
content_hi:
टमाटर अगेती झुलसा (Early Blight - Alternaria solani):
लक्षण: पत्तियों पर गोल, कत्थई रंग के छल्लेदार (Target-board) धब्बे।
उपचार: मैंकोजेब 75% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.0 ग्राम/लीटर पानी या एजोक्सीस्ट्रोबिन 23% एससी @ 1.0 मिली/लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें। तुड़ाई पूर्व अंतराल: 7-10 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIVR Tomato Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans) Advisory
content:
Crop: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
Disease: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
Region: Punjab & Northern Plains
Authoritative Source: ICAR-IIVR / ICAR-CPRI
Official Bulletin: https://iivr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Identification & Symptoms:
• Pale green to dark water-soaked greasy lesions rapidly enlarging on leaves and stems during cool, humid, cloudy weather.
• White cottony downy fungal growth visible on the underside of lesions in early morning hours.

2. Management Practices:
• Cultural: Ensure excellent field drainage; destroy volunteer solanaceous hosts.
• Chemical Treatment (CIBRC Approved):
  - Prophylactic: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L prior to disease onset.
  - Curative / At Outbreak: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.0 g/L.
• Safety & PHI: Pre-Harvest Interval is 14 days.
chemical_treatment: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb @ 2.0 g/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb CIBRC registered for late blight.
content_hi:
टमाटर पछेती झुलसा (Late Blight - Phytophthora infestans):
लक्षण: पत्तियों पर जलसिक्त अनियमित धब्बे, निचली सतह पर सफेद फफूंद।
उपचार: मेटालेक्सिल 8% + मैंकोजेब 64% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें। PHI: 14 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIVR Tomato Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas campestris) Advisory
content:
Crop: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
Disease: Bacterial Spot (Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria)
Region: Punjab & Multi-region
Authoritative Source: ICAR-IIVR / PAU
Official Bulletin: https://iivr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Symptoms & Management:
• Small circular water-soaked dark spots on leaves with faint yellow halos; scab-like lesions on green fruits.
• Cultural & Sanitation: Seed treatment with hot water (50°C for 25 min) or Streptocycline @ 100 ppm; avoid overhead irrigation.
• Chemical Treatment (CIBRC Approved): Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L tank-mixed with Streptocycline @ 100 ppm (1 g / 10 L water). PHI: 15 days.
cultural_precautions: Clean certified seed; avoid sprinkler irrigation.
chemical_treatment: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L + Streptocycline @ 100 ppm (1 g / 10 L).
cibrc_registration_details: Copper Oxychloride and Streptocycline approved for bacterial spot.
content_hi:
टमाटर जीवाणु पत्ती धब्बा (Bacterial Spot - Xanthomonas campestris):
उपचार: कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड 50% डब्ल्यूपी @ 2.5 ग्राम + स्ट्रेप्टोसाइक्लिन @ 100 ppm (1 ग्राम/10 लीटर पानी)। PHI: 15 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIVR Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV) Management Advisory
content:
Crop: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
Disease: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV)
Region: Punjab & National Vegetable Belts
Authoritative Source: ICAR-IIVR
Official Bulletin: https://iivr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

1. Symptoms & Management:
• Severe upward curling, vein chlorosis, stunted plant growth, flower abortion. Transmitted by Bemisia tabaci whitefly.
• Non-chemical: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20 / acre); use 40-50 mesh insect-proof nursery netting.
• Vector Management (CIBRC Approved): Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 mL/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3 g/L. PHI: 15 days.
cultural_precautions: Insect-proof nursery nets; yellow sticky traps.
sanitation_guidance: Rogue out virus infected plants immediately.
chemical_treatment: Vector control: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3 mL/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3 g/L.
cibrc_registration_details: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL CIBRC approved for whitefly vector on tomato.
content_hi:
टमाटर पत्ती मरोड़ विषाणु (TYLCV - सफेद मक्खी जनित):
प्रबंधन: पीले चिपचिपे प्रपंच (Yellow sticky traps) लगाएं। सफेद मक्खी नियंत्रण हेतु इमिडाक्लोप्रिड 17.8% एसएल @ 0.3 मिली/लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें। PHI: 15 दिन।

title: ICAR-IIVR Tomato General Healthy Crop Maintenance Advisory
content:
Crop: Tomato (Solanum lycopersicum)
Disease: Healthy Crop Maintenance & Balanced Nutrition
Region: Punjab & Multi-region
Authoritative Source: ICAR-IIVR
Official Bulletin: https://iivr.icar.gov.in
Retrieval Date: 2026-09-17
Match Level: Verified Exact Crop & Disease Match

• Balanced N-P-K fertigation, calcium nitrate foliar spray to prevent blossom end rot, regular scouting.
content_hi: टमाटर स्वस्थ फसल प्रबंधन: संतुलित पोषण एवं नियमित देखरेख बनाए रखें।
